MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, t, 2026 - CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) - CASE WHEN CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1) OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN DISTINCT p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
